questions.answer: Belt, rollers, guards, and emergency stops
options: Belt, rollers, guards, and emergency stops
questions.explanation: The operation sequence begins with inspecting these conveyor elements.

reviewCue.text: Review Flat Belt Conveyor Operation, slide 5. The operation sequence begins with inspecting these conveyor elements.
reviewCue.excerpt: 1. Inspect belt, rollers, guards, and emergency stops 2. Switch on main power supply 3. Start conveyor and run empty briefly 4. Load materials evenly on the belt 5. Monitor for smooth, safe operation 6. Stop conveyor after transfer is complete 7. Power off and…
